prompts.ctlflow:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a panoramic ornamental header for a technical documentation website. This is a NEW illustration, not a crop or resize of existing artwork.
Output geometry: exactly 1536 x 512 pixels, a very wide 3:1 transparent PNG. Keep the full composition inside this shallow banner. Horizontal rhythm across 90% of the canvas width; subjects occupy about 80% of its height. No large empty top or bottom padding, no tall central pile. All important shapes remain intact with a small clear outer margin.
Style: refined 1960s Andy Warhol-influenced silkscreen print, flat opaque spot-colour planes, crisp cut-paper silhouettes, elegant editorial draughtsmanship, sparse clean detail. No mottling or photographic grain.
Palette: five inks only, deep forest #153C2B, jade #45BD8B, coral #F17E8C, violet #6861D8, golden yellow #F1C861. Generous bright planes must remain legible on both pure white and near-black forest-green pages.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha-zero canvas and open gaps through shapes. Opaque ink inside the art. No opaque panel, white matte, checkerboard, backdrop, soft haze, cast shadow, glow, gradient or ground plane.
No text, letters, digits, labels, real brands, logos, diagrams, interface mockups, circuit boards, cute robots or stock corporate cartoons. Do not render a website or frame.
Subject for the ctlflow overview: an elegant low horizontal arrangement of three vintage reel-to-reel computing consoles seen straight on, each cabinet only slightly taller than its oversized tape reels. A long blank punched-paper strip makes one flowing lateral connection from the left reel to the right reel. A poised operator's hand enters from the left edge to guide the strip. Use offset jade, coral and violet cabinet silhouettes, golden circular reels, forest contours, and transparent spaces between the devices. The long lateral paper strip, repeated reels and separated low cabinets should make a complete art-school print composition across the shallow 3:1 canvas, not a tall mainframe tower.

Subject for Examples, whose first worked fleet is a fictional London theatre company: an elegant panoramic London West End street frontage. A low wide theatre entrance and blank shallow marquee occupy the middle, flanked by two partial Victorian facade wings. A small coral double-decker bus at the left and a fan of golden ticket stubs at the right establish London theatre without words. A slender jade street lamp, cut off gracefully below its finial so it stays within banner height, adds rhythm. Restrained architectural linework, coral awning, violet offset silhouette and open transparent doorways. Arrange everything laterally; no tall rooftop skyline, interior stage, curtains, people portraits, celebrities, real venue marks or lettering.

prompts.collaboration:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a large, wide editorial illustration for the ctlflow website hero about people working with their own agent fleets in Matrix rooms.
Create an original refined 1960s pop-art silkscreen composition with a strong Andy Warhol influence: repetition, bold flat spot-colour separations, elegant print registration, sophisticated magazine-cover draughtsmanship, not a cartoon mascot.
Subject: three overlapping large cameo portraits in profile, one recognizably human, one abstract geometric agent face, and another human, turned toward each other in conversation. Repeat one profile as a slightly offset coloured silhouette. Interlock two generous blank speech shapes with the portraits to suggest exchanging messages. No writing, no logos.
Composition: a single coherent horizontal cutout, approximately 3:2 canvas, subject occupies 85% of the width and 75% of the height, generous transparent negative space around and between the forms. Strong readable silhouettes; balanced open composition, not a rigid four-panel grid.
Palette: exactly five flat inks: deep forest green #153C2B, vivid jade #45BD8B, warm coral #F17E8C, saturated ultramarine-violet #6861D8, golden yellow #F1C861. Use coral, jade and gold for large luminous planes and dark green only for elegant facial details. Colours should pop on both pure white and very dark green pages.
Genuinely transparent PNG background, including the gaps between shapes. No opaque backdrop, no white rectangle, no printed checkerboard, no cast shadow or ground plane. No gradients, photographic shading, 3D, fine grain, tiny dots, textures, circuit boards, generic friendly robots, lettering, frames or slogans. The result is tasteful flat-colour print artwork, not an infographic or UI screenshot.
